message.content: In December, Los Angeles enjoys mild winter weather. The average daily high is about **18 °C (64 °F)**, while the average low dips to roughly **10 °C (50 °F)**. Taking the mean of those two gives an overall average temperature of around **14 °C (57 °F)** for the month. This makes December one of the cooler but still comfortable months in LA, with plenty of sunshine and relatively low humidity.
